db:section.db:title: Detailed Description
db:section.db:para: Test struct similar to QQuaternion::AxisAndAngle to reproduce the bug. Contains multiple anonymous types to force Clang path-based naming.

db:section.db:title: struct AxisAndAngle<AngleT>::(unnamed struct) AxisAndAngle::axis
db:section.db:para: The 3D axis that together with an angle corresponds to a quaternion.
An unnamed struct containing members x, y, z.

db:section.db:title: struct AxisAndAngle<AngleT>::(unnamed struct) AxisAndAngle::rotationCache
db:section.db:para: Cached rotation data with multiple anonymous types to trigger disambiguation.

db:section.db:title: union AxisAndAngle<AngleT>::(unnamed union) AxisAndAngle::transformationMatrix
db:section.db:para: Complex nested anonymous types similar to Qt's real patterns.
